notes.title: Steam Next Fest Demo Release
notes.notes: [h1]STEAM NEXT FEST DEMO[/h1][p][/p][h3]The Steam Next Fest starts on June 9th but you can already play the new demo for SEMP 64![/h3][p][/p][list][*][p][b]New Level[/b] - About twice as large as the previous one[/p][/*][*][p][b]Carry Players[/b] - Press 'F' or the left stick to get carried by another player[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Level Mechanics[/b] - Spikeballs, blades and more[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Music[/b] - Listen to the first two original tracks for SEMP 64 by SpielmitStil[/p][/*][*][p][b]Speedrun Mode[/b] - Start a speedrun that automatically tracks your times[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug fixes[/b] - Oh so many bug fixes[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][previewyoutube="TUCWYov2Leg;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Steam Next Fest Update
notes.notes:
[url=https://discord.gg/hkmEXQDYwm][img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1149627284689530979/1375406827239510078/old-new.png?ex=683192ed&is=6830416d&hm=51a85a4399c87a5d51d351f3df0535be137d5b2a43124fee0bce0784f65f43eb&=&format=webp&quality=lossless&width=1872&height=527[/img][/url]

[h1]Steam Next Fest Update[/h1]

A new map will be playable when the Steam Next Fest starts on June 9th!
It's much larger, has new level elements, new challenges and has a lot more to offer.

Make sure to check out the update once it drops, even if you've already completed the current level.


The update also features some new player mechanics and of course a loot of bug fixes.
It may even adds a few new cosmetics, who knows.


Hope to see you there on June 9th!

notes.title: SEMP 64 Demo Release
notes.notes:
The demo version of SEMP 64 is releasing on April 25th at 8:00 am GMT+2!

Play an exclusive level alone or with your friends (or together with up to 99 other players).
Will you be able to beat the level? 👀

Feedback is well appreciated and will obviously be used to improve the final product. So feel free to let me know what you like and/or dislike either on [url=https://x.com/byXToGo]Twitter[/url] or [url=https://discord.gg/hkmEXQDYwm]Discord[/url].
